532:t_1:3.en: ～Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$～

532:t_1:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「So you do consider $c exceptional.」

532:t_1:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It is a serious matter that those who have reached such a level have been left unchecked.」

532:t_1:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That is probably due to who governs this universe... and the dimensional cage.」

532:t_1:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

532:t_1:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It does not concern you yet.」

532:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty. In other words, I'm half-fledged until I bring back the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

532:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing to add.」

532:t_1:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「May I accompany you?」

532:t_1:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「My target is not the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

532:t_1:17.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's the one who disturbs your void, then.」

532:t_1:19.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I understand. Just imagining getting caught in your killing intent makes me sick.」

532:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「This half-fledged girl will obediently stay home.」

532:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Heh... She is an interesting woman.」

532:t_1:23.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Without at least that much spirit, she would not deserve a seat here.」

532:t_1:24.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「In that sense, all of $c's $$リアクター$$s possess the requisite power, including the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

532:t_1:25.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「There are actually two humans who can awaken it.」

532:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That is probably due to this planet Earth's exceptional nature.」

532:t_1:27.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gather here...? Or do they gather here precisely because of that...?」

532:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And the power possessed by this planet's humans is gradually taking shape...」

532:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Our front lines are fraying in response to $c's movements across the world. At this rate, the tide could turn.」

532:t_1:32.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Be careful, $$尸空#pilot$$. I still cannot read their intentions...」

532:t_1:36.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Captain's Cabin～

532:t_1:38.en:
$$レイス$$
「I'm glad the ARX-8 proved useful.」

532:t_1:39.en:
$$宗介$$
「Intelligence must have had a hard time since $$ミスリル$$ was destroyed.」

532:t_1:40.en:
$$レイス$$
「We did. But we can't let $$アマルガム$$ or the Empire do whatever they want with the world.」

532:t_1:41.en:
$$レイス$$
「Intelligence is acting independently. Sending your AS's core unit to the research division's survivors was one such operation.」

532:t_1:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I was surprised when you contacted me during the battle, $$レイス$$.」

532:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I thought the ARX Project... had been completely terminated.」

532:t_1:44.en:
$$レイス$$
「It is true that the project was frozen after the chief developer died.」

532:t_1:45.en:
$$レイス$$
「But $$アル$$ himself requested a new body, so development of the ARX-8 resumed and it was completed.」

532:t_1:46.en:
$$レイス$$
「Incidentally, $$アル$$ chose the name $$レーバテイン$$ himself. Do you know its origin?」

532:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「I asked a friend who knows about the occult. Apparently, it's the name of a sword in mythology.」

532:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He probably chose that name as something more powerful than the great crossbow, the $$アーバレスト$$.」

532:t_1:49.en:
$$レイス$$
「Still, gaining a talented member of the research staff probably played a major role in its completion.」

532:t_1:51.en:
$$レイス$$
「Yes. $$クダン・ミラ$$ was involved in its development.」

532:t_1:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... This $$クダン・ミラ$$ is, as I thought...」

532:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... She is a 《$$ウィスパード$$》, just like $$カナメ$$ and me.」

532:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Don't you remember the girl you rescued in $$シベリア$$ before becoming $$カナメ$$'s bodyguard, $$相良$$?」

532:t_1:58.en:
$$レイス$$
「$$ミラ$$ has a message for you, Sergeant. She wants to see you and thank you for what you did then.」

532:t_1:59.en:
$$レイス$$
「I doubt you have time for that now, though.」

532:t_1:61.en:
$$レイス$$
「Our investigation also confirms a change in $$アマルガム$$'s organizational structure.」

532:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is changing from a democratic organization governed by consensus into one with a dictatorial power structure.」

532:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「And the one at its head is...」

532:t_1:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

532:t_1:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to $$カナメ$$'s transmission, he is currently hovering between life and death.」

532:t_1:66.en:
$$レイス$$
「$$アマルガム$$ probably won't act openly until his condition becomes clear.」

532:t_1:67.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I'll leave tracking them to Intelligence. Please investigate their movements and their organization's ultimate objective.」

532:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I cannot believe that $$レナード$$ has truly sworn loyalty to the Empire.」

532:t_1:70.en:
$$レイス$$
「You mean the $$時空震動$$ bombs $$アマルガム$$ developed.」

532:t_1:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... We urgently need to determine what he intends to use them for.」

532:t_1:72.en:
$$レイス$$
「I understand. What will $c do in the meantime?」

532:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will head to $$新日本$$, as $$ゼロ$$ also suggested.」

532:t_1:77.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

532:t_1:79.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I feel the same. I love you.」

532:t_1:80.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$. The first line was, '$$宗介$$... I love you.'」

532:t_1:81.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$アル$$. I'm Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$.」

532:t_1:82.en:
$$アル$$
「I congratulate you on your promotion, Master Sergeant.」

532:t_1:83.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. I'm counting on you to remember that.」

532:t_1:84.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Wait, $$アル$$... Did you record that whole exchange between $$かなめ$$ and $$宗介$$?」

532:t_1:85.en:
$$アル$$
「It might contain important information, so I recorded everything.」

532:t_1:86.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Give me that data! Now I've got some great material for teasing $$宗介$$!」

532:t_1:88.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$マオ$$ is right! There's a limit to how tasteless you can be!」
